openings.claim: A local script replaces timestamp-first scanning with a manifest-position boundary ledger plus targeted ambiguity checks; this handles evidence, not divergence causes. Align records by manifest identifiers and dictionary-defined artifact boundaries; classify digests equal/unequal/unavailable and leave blank warnings blank. Equal recorded inputs with unequal outputs support stage-local mismatch; unequal inputs point upstream. Cite records for every definite stage; claim earliest in expected-stage order only after earlier recorded boundaries are accounted for, otherwise give an interval containing unresolved earlier boundaries. Separate execution chronology uncertainty, including the inverted export timestamp.
openings.discriminator: Rival: timestamp-first scanning stops at its first digest mismatch. Candidate stages may differ for the inverted-timestamp pair. Transform-record removal should preserve/widen uncertainty, never imply nonexecution or increase certainty. These behaviors are predictions, not observations.
openings.probe: On disjoint three-pair subsets, apply ledger versus rival within sixty analyst minutes; freeze referenced outputs and inspection logs before opening two sealed answer sheets. In twenty additional minutes compare supported locations, injected-boundary interval containment, ordering-sensitive decisions and inspection counts. Review stipulated removals with unchanged manifests. Rank available records by discrimination of earliest remaining alternatives; log every manual inspection, stop at twelve per pair. Exhaustion yields unresolved plus an available-record next check, not extra inspection.
openings.uncertainty: Manifest/dictionary boundary matching may fail: leave ambiguity unresolved. Defeat: incomparable digests, inconsistent identifiers, or an interval excluding the sealed boundary. Disjoint subsets test feasibility and describe errors, not controlled performance. A time cap alone cannot establish feasibility; actual completion/logs must show six referenced reports with resource-fitting next checks. No live access or reliable effect assumed.

lineage.reason: Retains relation, rival, removal challenge, defeat conditions, uncertainty, resource/stopping caveats and declared preserves fit.

decision: Retain D1 for a bounded synthetic probe. Observed mismatches remain distinct from explanations; no measured outcome or feasibility is established.
